profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: Experienced iOS Engineer. Working on the Apple Camera Experience Team. Strong background in software engineering with a Master's degree in Computer Science from DePaul University.

positions.title: Camera Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on the Apple iOS Camera App:

- iPhone Duo 
- iOS26 redesign 
- Smart Take
- Center Stage front camera
- Spatial video and photo capture

positions.title: Senior iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of Twitter’s iOS Home Timeline Team for the duration of my tenure. The team is responsible for the code that powers the home timeline as well as infrastructure code that powers all timelines in the app (profiles, lists, trends, etc.). 

Worked on a cross-functional project to improve the Lists feature. Add pinned Lists to home. Rebuilt the List management and detail pages. Migrated API endpoints to GraphQL. Added custom banner images read/write to Lists, and built a Lists To Follow recommendation module on the home timeline. 

Optimized advertisement spacing in the home timeline to prevent users from seeing too many ads or ads in invalid positions.

iOS tech lead on a project to improve the way people navigate in the home timeline, the goal was to improve impression rates of highest rated tweets and improve time-to-first-tweet timeline performance metrics. Experimented with timeline choice UX. Improved the timeline auto-refresh experience. We also improved the way client-side timeline caches are cleared, and timeline responses are de-duplicated.

positions.title: Mobile Engineer
positions.description:
I was the lead and only iOS and Android Engineer for a hotel room booking app. Responsible for all software design, maintenance, and new feature development. The apps were growing revenue ~25% per year, and had tens of thousands of users. 

Made significant contributions to improve funnel conversion rates and revenue, such as rebuilding and redesigning the hotel details page and checkout page. I also AB tested many changes to the hotel search page.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
Rebuilt Morningstar’s flagship consumer app from scratch, built in Swift. I was involved in all the large design and architecture decisions. 

Maintained and added features to an existing iPad app built in Objective-C. I also helped to improve code coverage by leading an initiative to improve unit and UI testing within the family of app we maintained.
